title: NovelKeys made a beige mouse to go with its beige keyboards.
summary: The $85 NK-M1 ’s features are pretty standard for an 8K wireless gaming mouse in 2026, but it’s lightweight, its buttons and scroll wheel feel good, and its colors are classic .
